A "Super Kite" Built by the enigmatic genius known as the Kite Crafter. While these ship designs may hold forms close to the ubiquitous Kite, many debate on whether it still is a Kite on account for the overhauled specs and design changes.

The Vermillion is the Kite Crafter's way of making the Kite into a missile fighter, combining parts and design aspects of the Vigilance and--as rumors say--parts of the Sentry wardrone. In any case, the Vermillion is outfitted with nothing but missile hardpoints and a system to capitalize on it. With missile points generally having no to low flux costs, the design retrofitted some flux parts in exchange for improved engines and thrusters.

The Kite Crafter's way of making the Kite into a High Tech warship, the Cerulean features improved shielding and flux components alongside a medium energy port. Rumour has it that the Kite Crafter managed to implement designs from Remnant drones into the Super Kite design.

The Gamboge is the Kite Crafter's way of making the Kite a proper gunship. Using design elements from the Lasher and Brawler, the Gamboge carries enough gun ports to utilize its Accelerated Ammo Feeder system. Added armor helps the Gamboge trade salvos against other ships its size.
